title: identities.json local_credentials
description: The local password credentials of the person: that one exists, when the password changed and whether TOTP is enrolled. Never the password hash, the TOTP secret or the lockout state.

identity_id.description: ID of the linked identity the credential belongs to.

password_changed_at.description: When the password was last set.

totp_enrolled.description: Whether a second factor with TOTP is enrolled.

totp_enabled_at.description: When TOTP was enrolled; absent when it is not.
